title: Apply for Rentstart Move assistance
summary: Find out if you are eligible and how to apply for Rentstart Move assistance if you are moving from public housing to a private rental.

faqs.a: Rentstart Move is an interest-free loan that can cover up to 100% of your rental bond. If the landlord or real estate agent does not claim the money at the end of your tenancy, the amount you repaid to Homes NSW is returned to you.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for Rentstart Move?
faqs.a: You may be eligible if you are leaving public housing for your own reason or due to changes in your income and assets, have a nil or credit balance on your rent and Homes NSW accounts, have less than $5,000 in cash assets, and the private rental rent is no more than 60% of your household's total gross weekly income.
The assistance is based on how much of your income is spent on rent, calculated over a 12 or 18-month period, and requires you to make fortnightly payments to Homes NSW.
